**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2022/01/15 (Sat) 13:18
- [USER] User inquired about the key differences between B2B and B2C.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The key differences between B2B (business-to-business) and B2C (business-to-consumer) include the target market, the buying process, and the sales process.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2B companies sell products or services to other businesses, while B2C companies sell directly to consumers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The buying process for B2B is usually more complex and involves multiple decision-makers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2C purchases are typically made by individuals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2B sales often involve longer-term relationships and contracts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2C sales are typically one-time transactions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2B marketing often emphasizes the technical features and capabilities of a product or service.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] B2C marketing focuses on emotional appeals and the benefits to the consumer.
